title: Membership Delivery Benefits on Northgate Orders
content:
This is the single statement of the Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships delivery and return-pickup benefits that apply to Northgate orders.

**Status.** A delivery benefit applies only when the membership status on the order date is one of the tier's benefit statuses. The status is read from the membership record as of the order date. No benefit applies on payment hold, since paid benefits do not apply during a hold on any tier.

**Benefits.**
1. Where the tier sets a free standard shipping threshold, standard shipping on a Ship to Home order is free when the order's merchandise subtotal is at least that amount; Northgate Rewards adds nothing to the standard shipping rule of Northgate Store and Online Orders.
2. Where the tier includes Same-Day Delivery, the Same-Day Delivery fee is waived when the merchandise subtotal is at least the tier's same-day minimum, a smaller same-day order pays the tier's member same-day fee in place of the standard fee, and an express order pays the tier's member express fee in place of the standard express fee.
3. Where the tier includes free return pickup, the member may schedule a from-home return pickup of eligible Northgate-sold items at no fee.

**Merchandise subtotal.** The merchandise subtotal is the sum of the order's line prices after item promotions and before the Northgate Card discount, Northgate Cash, gift cards, tax and fees.

**Exclusions.** Delivery benefits never apply to the fulfilment programs and item types the tier excludes from delivery benefits, whose fees are set by the order or marketplace rules alone.

**Stacking.** Membership benefits only waive or reduce delivery and pickup fees and never reduce merchandise prices, so they combine with the Northgate Card discount, item promotions, price adjustments and Northgate Cash without interaction. When another source (a promotional free-delivery offer or a Northgate Card shipping benefit) also lowers the same fee, the fee charged is the single lowest fee any one source yields; sources are never added together and a fee never goes below zero.

**Benefit uses.** A benefit use is recorded for each order on which the membership benefit produced that lowest fee, including ties with another source, and its amount is the standard fee minus the fee charged. The value of each recorded use follows the tier's benefit value basis, the fee avoided.

**Other tier benefits.** The other tier benefits are the fuel discount in cents per gallon, the streaming subscription where the tier includes it, the hours of early deal access and, where the tier supports it, tax-exempt checkout under the tax-exemption rule of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms); of these only streaming activations are recorded as benefit uses.

**Worked cases (hypothetical standard fee of 9.00 on a same-day order with a 20.00 merchandise subtotal, member on a paid Northgate+ tier in active status)**

| Other source on the same fee | Fee charged | Benefit use recorded | Value of the use |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | 6.99 (member same-day fee) | yes | 2.01 |
| promotional offer yielding 5.00 | 5.00 | no | — |
| promotional offer yielding 6.99 | 6.99 (tie) | yes | 2.01 |
